behaviour: Document the backstage.io/former-names annotation in well-known-annotations.md.
rules: 1. Add a `### backstage.io/former-names` section with a YAML example showing `backstage.io/former-names: old-service, legacy/old-service`.

2. Explain that the value is a comma-separated list of entity references (`[<kind>:][<namespace>/]<name>`, defaulting missing kind and namespace to the declaring entity's own kind and namespace, and requiring the same kind as the declaring entity) by which the entity was previously known.

3. Document the redirect behaviour on the Catalog entity page and TechDocs reader page (preserving sub-paths and showing a rename notice) and the limitations (a live entity at a reference always takes precedence over any former-name claim; former-name claims must share the same kind and, when a retained refresh-state record exists for the former name, the same source location/origin provenance; contested names claimed by more than one entity are rejected as not-found so no entity can hijack another's links; permissions on the target entity are enforced so unauthorized users receive not-found; stored relations and other plugins are not rewritten).
